Definition: to hide (by covering), literally or figuratively
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hide, conceal; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to hide oneself; 1a2) to be hidden, be concealed; 1b) (Piel) to hide carefully; 1c) (Pual) to be hidden carefully, be concealed; 1d) (Hiphil) to conceal, hide; 1e) (Hithpael) to hide oneself carefully
